<!-- pr-reviewer: 9479d9faa9d781b0aa5849def2e1451adb7c0cb9 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** P3 post fix. Clean trial merge with main (e6849c5a), touched post suites and clippy clean, example catalog suites pass. The two blocking points of the previous review (spaced NC strings, unknown models, no-identity machines; the stale citation) are closed.

### What is good
- The fix is the right shape: `G04 F<s>` (cycle 9) for every DIN/ISO dwell, no `FUNCTION DWELL` at all in the ISO post. This follows the research in `docs/research/heidenhain/` (qsmits' comment on this PR): no ISO source confirms `FUNCTION DWELL` in an ISO program.
- The `supportsFunctionDwell()` function is gone, so a machine file with no identity, a spaced NC string or an unknown model gets the safe form. That closes the defect the previous round flagged.
- The pinning test asserts the one form across controllers, versions, spaced NC strings, the unknown model and the default machine. The stale `p. 456: FUNCTION DWELL TIME<seconds>` citation is gone; the header now names cycle 9 only.
- No golden files, machine files, examples or snapshots changed. The body matches the diff.

### Results (locally, trial merge of 9479d9faa with origin/main e6849c5a; trial merge clean, no conflicts)

Build: `cargo test -p camcraft-post --no-run`, then the suites below, then `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (1m 30s on the merged tree).

- Suites the diff touches (in the merged tree): `heidenhain_block_form` 6/6 (incl. the new `heidenhain_dwell_writes_g04_f_in_iso_for_all_controllers_and_defaults`), `heidenhain_cycles` 11/11 (the changed `nonzero_entry_peck_and_deep_and_backbore_keep_the_expanded_chain` assertion is updated).
- Other dwell/heidenhain post suites: `heidenhain_arc_centre` 2/2, `bore_cycle` 9/9, `cycle_dwell` 9/9, `dwell_cycles_modal_p` 5/5, `expanded_bore_refusal` 5/5, `g73_g85_dwell_linuxcnc` 9/9, `g83_dwell` 7/7, `g83_dwell_linuxcnc` 2/2, `ream_cycle` 5/5, `script_heidenhain` 16/16, `script_heidenhain_klartext` 23/23. All pass.
- Example catalog suites, run by name on the merged tree: `example_catalog` 43 passed (4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` 1/1, `example_catalog_edge_work` 1/1, `catalog_groove_part_off` 1/1.
- Heidenhain-adjacent app suites, run on the merged tree: `conformance` 7/7, `bore_cycle` 4/4, `drill_rplane` 8/8, `first_part_programs` 2/2, `golden_cl` 34/34, `post_cycle_feed_spindle` 8/8, `post_spindle_rule_all` 5/5, `probe_op` 12/12, `tapping_mode` 4/4. All pass.

### Targeted tests (step 5)
- Example catalog suites: run above, all pass.
- Light lane (the 6 light twins, in release, on the merged tree, by the exact twin names and commands from the light plan): `motion light: lib` 6/6 (the_pocket_face..._light, without_lift_room..._light, explicit_trochoidal..._light, custom_parameters..._light, custom_return_feed..._light, the_slot..._light), adaptive_troch_island, adaptive_troch_neck, adaptive_troch_parallel (3 + 2 light tests, all pass), `app light: pocket_pass_start` 1/1. Note: the full `cargo xtask gate light` build step (all app and motion test binaries in release) was not run; the machine was under heavy load from parallel reviews. The 6 light steps themselves ran and passed.
- P3, not on the safety floor's heavy path: no targeted heavy step.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Nothing blocking. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand (fork contributor's PR).
- One note for the branch owner: `main` received a fix for a stale app test (`start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs` missing `entry:`, commit 5cf0aa953) after this branch was cut. The trial merge brings in that fix; the merged tree is green. Do not rebase; merge `origin/main` to refresh at merge time.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
